title: Reader Chapter 29
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

examples.title: Brisa grips the clipboard at the studio door
examples.scenario: Brisa steadies a clipboard with loose waiver forms at Thursday 6:05 p.m. in the mirrored lobby of Vale Dance, assistant instructor, with rosin dust on the floor. 'You skipped my daughter again,' a parent says. Brisa starts to defend the audition list. The parent adds, 'She thinks you don't see her.' Brisa feels the word unfair rise and stop. Brisa she must answer the hurt without pretending she knows the parent's motive.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.

examples.title: Dima straightens the crooked badge
examples.scenario: Dima touches a crooked hospital badge at Monday 6:58 a.m. in the cardiac ICU locker room, new attending, with steam on the mirror. A senior nurse questioned his order in front of the team. Dima has a reply ready about protocol, but the badge in the mirror makes the real threat clear: maybe he is not ready for this role. Dima he must decide whether to defend his identity or check the order like a doctor who can learn.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.
